capabilities: switch themes automatically on a time schedule
configure separate day and night themes with toggle times
toggle between day and night themes from a ribbon icon
pause automatic switching for the rest of the day
extras: The README lists the ribbon toggle under both Features and Future Features (struck through), suggesting partially outdated documentation.
problem: Obsidian only switches themes manually, so users who want light themes by day and dark themes by night have to change them themselves.
summary: Theme scheduler that automatically switches Obsidian between a day (light) theme and a night (dark) theme at set times.
